## Use this when

- IBM i estate assessment before changing production
- AS/400 estate assessment before upgrading or modernizing
- find undocumented IBM i dependencies before a maintenance window
- IBM i 7.4 support is ending and I need an upgrade plan
- assess an IBM i or AS/400 estate before upgrading
- map RPG CL COBOL DB2 jobs and integrations before IBM i modernization
- I am worried an IBM i upgrade will break batch jobs interfaces or vendor software
- help modernize JDE World or a custom IBM i workload without losing business behavior
- build a rollback test and evidence plan before changing an IBM i production system
- find undocumented dependencies in an IBM i workload
- AS/400 modernization assessment
- IBM i upgrade proof

## Problem

An organization running IBM i / AS/400 workloads needs to understand application, database, job, integration, hardware and vendor dependencies before a support-transition upgrade or modernization creates an outage or hidden compatibility failure.

## Inputs

A bounded authorized estate or workload description. Deeper work may use customer-supplied inventories, source listings, job schedules, configuration exports, vendor/version details and other evidence the customer is authorized to provide.

## Outputs

Dependency map, verified-vs-unknown upgrade assumptions, compatibility risk register, test and rollback plan, and a human-review-ready next-step package. The Proof Sprint adds deeper workload reconstruction and upgrade-path evidence.

## Pricing

$250 IBM i Estate X-Ray; $250 IBM i 7.4 Deadline X-Ray; $1,500 IBM i Upgrade Proof Sprint.

- IBM i Estate X-Ray: $250 (one_time)

- IBM i 7.4 Deadline X-Ray: $250 (one_time)

- IBM i Upgrade Proof Sprint: $1,500 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE HUMAN HANDOFF: external GitHub-runner canary verified live Machine Commerce offer discovery, fixed-price service handoff, human review page, all three bounded tiers, zero checkout/payment creation, and HTTP reachability of the IBM i Rescue human buyer route. Machine Commerce may direct a human to that route. Product-specific direct machine checkout remains canary-pending; paid state still requires provider verification and production change remains outside this capability.

Agents may discover IBM i Rescue and surface the smallest relevant paid option. Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout or paid work. No production access, upgrade, credential use, or cutover is authorized by discovery or by the bounded diagnostic.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments; the human buyer route and backend checkout-session creation are live-verified. Direct machine checkout remains intentionally unexposed, and paid state still requires authoritative provider verification.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
